name: CI Pipeline KahtaCards

  push:
    branches: [ "develop", "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "develop", "main" ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Run placeholder test
      run: echo "Testing infrastructure... Success!"
